notes.title: Patch Notes 7/17/2023
notes.content:
- Minor bug fixes.
- Improvements to online stability.
- Fixed a soft lock that could occur for Spanish language players on the 14th floor of the dungeon.
- Various text fixes.

notes.title: Etrian Odyssey III HD is Out Now!
notes.content:
Venture into the unknown in Etrian Odyssey III HD, now available for the first time on PC!  

[previewyoutube=RSeXc8JwwFw;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase Etrian Odyssey III HD before 6/14 to receive in-game character portraits of Nahobino from Shin Megami Tensei V and Aigis from Persona 3! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43618251/1b75919acf6eb08000891a71d25e53dc92f96f53.png[/img]

Intrigued by the legend, many explorers gathered in Armoroad, all hoping to challenge the undersea labyrinth. But so far, none have found the fabled sunken city. Set sail to Armoroad to navigate the Yggdrasil Labyrinth, find the drowned city, and win fortune and glory!

Build your own party of explorers from the all-new twelve different character classes. Descend the labyrinth that swallowed the mystery of Armoroad and the drowned city.

Etrian Odyssey III HD Features: [list]

[*] Newly remastered graphics, remastered soundtrack and quality of life improvements, including difficulty selection and save slots

[*] Easy access to the Monstrous Codex, quest log and skill tree

[*] Maximize your adventuring by optimizing your party, and choose the character classes that work for your playstyle.

[/list] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810820/Etrian_Odyssey_III_HD/]Etrian Odyssey III HD is now available on Steam![/url]
